items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, but I was saying, when Sonny Cohn came to the band I was telling you who he replaced. ... Then they got Sonny Cohn.

ctx.x: Yeah, you, Thad Jones, Al Aarons, and Sonny Cohn.

Sonny Cohn. Well, I remember when Sonny Cohn came to the band and I remember when Al Aarons come to the band. Who did Sonny Cohn? Oh, that‘s when the trumpet player that, what‘s his name said something to and he got off and left.
Oh, right, you said that Marshall Royal said something to him and he got off and left.
